steps.name: 01 Settings
steps.goal: Open Settings: tap the Navigation button, then tap Settings in the side menu.
steps.done: The Settings screen shows the Computer section and a Control Computer row.

steps.name: 02 Open and control Computer
steps.goal: Tap Control Computer. When the Computer screen opens, tap Take control.
steps.done: The Computer is in Controlling mode and explains the trackpad gesture.
expect: Drag to move the pointer. Tap to click.
